evidence.label_semantics: cartesian: achieved motion FK(q_obs[k+1]) relative to FK(q_obs[k]) in task frame (D-003 C); gripper_target from leader_action (D-013); proprio 13 floats (D-008 A); FK: Menagerie so101 gripperframe with provisional real->sim joint map (configs/task.yaml)

protocol.coverage: All held-out valid actions scored exactly once: episode-local anchors 0,2,4,..., first two predicted actions; exclude extrapolated terminal labels and padding.
protocol.observation: Recorded real iPhone image and recorded 13-D state at each anchor; no simulated images or rollout feedback.
protocol.zero_baseline: Six zero arm deltas; absolute gripper target held at the observed gripper at the inference anchor for both prefix actions. No future gripper input.
protocol.prediction_clipping: Raw denormalized predictions, before execution-side delta/gripper clipping; identical to offline error convention.
protocol.arm_active: Recorded translation norm >1 mm OR rotation-vector norm >0.01 rad per 100 ms tick; stationary is the exact complement.
protocol.near_zero_arm: Recorded translation <=0.1 mm AND rotation <=0.001 rad per tick.
protocol.reviewed_stationary_ball_approach_proxy: Action tick present in the existing reviewed stationary-ball paired-image eligibility file. A phase proxy, not an independent grasp annotation.
protocol.observed_gripper_closure_proxy: Next recorded follower gripper minus current <=-0.01 (one percentage point) per tick; includes any closure anywhere in an episode.
protocol.upward_with_gripper_at_most_45pct_proxy: Recorded dz >1 mm and current follower gripper <=45%; describes upward relatively-closed-hand motion, not confirmed object lift.
protocol.phase_overlap: Phase proxies can overlap; only active/stationary partition the dataset.
protocol.interpretation: Single fixed thresholds are descriptive, not tuned to either model. No fitting, retraining, label edits, split changes or closed-loop success claims. Cartesian measurements inherit the existing provisional real-to-sim FK mapping. Temporal samples within an episode remain correlated.
